name: land_step
_comment: U9 wave 4: landing range AT REST. Kit Crawler 100 requests landing, flies out 16 s (~700 px), brakes, turns 180 deg, then steps back in: 0.5 s thrust (~24 px), brake, and `l` at rest, 34 times (one keys step, no gaps). The first stop that lands is inside the range; read each stop's distance with planet_track.mjs `at_read` (per-frame, no line fit). Pilots w4_land_*.
